notes.title: New Languages Available in SLaM Patch!
notes.content:
"Aveggers! Aveggers! Aveggers! Aveggers!" As you can see here, we've added four new languages so that the game is fully understood throughout the Solar System!

✅ French, Italian, German, Spanish!

And more!
✅ Steam cloud saves for when you're travelling off-world!
✅ General fixes to block Mushroomian worms from entering our hard drives!
